title: bursera penicillata
intro: Bursera penicillata, commonly known as Oreganillo or Copal, is a species of tree in the family Burseraceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, inflammation, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Bursera penicillata are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified in various studies.
